comment: No source is published. The panel prints CTRL under the encoder, DRUM1 over DRUM2 on one switch, EXCL over IND on the other, and CV IN, TR1, TR2 and OUT on the jacks; the maker configured no jack names. The 64 samples are 64 wav files in the installed res/drum_samples folder. The encoder line names sample, pitch and decay because those are the three per-voice values the module saves into the patch; the maker's hardware manual has the encoder pressed to move between them with its lamp colour showing which, green for pitch, red for decay and orange for volume, and that gesture was not confirmed in this build. Volume is offered as a CV destination on the menu but is not among the saved per-voice values. The four menu items are the maker's own.
